title: Read-only exact source Claim version view
description: A derived address for the exact historical or current record cited by a source. The initial reader handles declared public source Claims. It neither rewrites a Claim nor assigns its identity to the version view, and unavailable bytes never fall back to another version.

record.description: The complete selected source Claim only. Its canonical digest, claim_id and claim_version must equal record_ref; raw stream byte fixity is separate provenance. No current source substitution or neighboring stream records.

provenance.description: Bounded source-reader evidence: exact public catalog binding, selected package/archive and raw byte fixity. This is not authority configuration, a use grant, or the complete source stream.

navigationNode.description: Closed source-navigation carrier: all original fields belong inside the exact-digest-bound record, never in generic display, authority or Claim convenience fields.
